brief: #footydraft FREE PICK DRAFT screen — exhibition at mockups/free-pick.html. 20 of 21 macrostructures, one per frame; Feature Stack excluded (needs scroll). Petrol FIXED, no switcher; type held to Oswald+Inter so all variety is structural and the winner ports without a type swap. NO MOTION — static first-look only, by instruction. One internally consistent draft state across all 20: Free Pick / Top 5 leagues / 1 per club / 4 drafters / round 5 of 11 / pick 18 of 44 / your turn / 9s. Every player, club, crest, nation and age verified against player_data.csv; config verified viable against src/data/draftViability.ts. Design decision: NO ability ratings and NO pool counts on screen (data-model facts, PROJECT.md keeps them off), and Free Pick has no currency — so the only numerals are the clock, the round and the pick number. Unavailable rows dimmed WHOLE so crests are never filtered. RESOLVED — Mert picked off this run.

brief: #footydraft multiplayer lobby at /lobby/:code, plus the name gate that both Create and Join pass through. No exhibition — a deliberate re-use of Split Studio from the single-player lobby at different knob values: the room code takes the left half's display slot instead of a heading, a chat fills the dead space under the table, and host/guest are two readings of the same settings panel (interactive vs. static chips). Petrol fixed, Oswald+Inter, crests unfiltered. Project rule changed this session: FAKE THE FUNCTIONALITY — screens simulate the backend they don't have (people arrive on a stagger, chat sends, a handed-over code already has a host behind it) instead of shipping honest dead ends.
